question.text: Mr. Patel, a 45-year-old entrepreneur, has irregular income. His PMS IPS should:

answer.text: Explicitly allow lumpy contributions and higher liquidity buffer

explanation.text: The Logic: Irregular income needs flexibility and higher liquidity buffer in IPS. The Trap: Assuming fixed SIPs misrepresents client reality. Cross-Exam Context: Same guidance in X-B for HNI/entrepreneur clients. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Link top-ups to business cash cycle (e.g., post-GST refund, post-bonus months).
